title: Usage event v1
description: One usage event, as the API Gateway sends it and as it travels through Kafka (docs/contracts/usage-event/README.md). Not expressible here, checked by core.Validate: event_time within [now - 7 days, now + 5 min] and attributes at most 4 KB. Unknown properties are allowed, so a reader of v1 accepts a later version that adds one.

event_id.description: Set once by the sender and kept on every retry. Part of the dedup key (ADR-0007).

event_time.description: RFC 3339. Set once by the sender and kept on every retry. Part of the dedup key.

attributes.description: Free-form per metric; for api_calls: method, path (no query string), status, duration_ms, request_bytes, response_bytes. Never headers, query strings or bodies. Integers may exceed 2^53 and must not pass through float64.
